full_text: Camp Office, May 19, 1941. No.7 Camp, Eastern Command. Dear Mr.Pietruschka, this goes to express our sincere gratitude and appreciation of the work you have done in this Camp. We can say without exaggeration that the success of our Recreation and Musical Department was to a large measure due to your virtuosity on the violin. During the past nine months there was no show or musical performance in which you did not play a prominent part, and it gives us great pleasure to thank you for your unceasing efforts and devotion in this small way. Let us say that your art has been a great help to your fellow internees in difficult times.
